Megan (CSM): Quick heads-up — ArcadiaLabs onboarding: seeing p95 ~220ms on chat generate during peak and token costs creeping up. Thinking a proactive plan: int8 compact swap + 10% weighted route to dedicated pool as a canary. Want to avoid surprises before renewal. Thoughts?
Sam (Solutions): Do we have baseline quality numbers for the compact model? any eval diffs yet?
Megan (CSM): Ran a small eval (1k prompts from their summary set). Summary ROUGE dropped ~0.3%, hallucination checks unchanged. I'm attaching CSV to the playbook (will paste link in thread).
Devin (ML Eng): Sounds reasonable. Recommend redwood/llama-compact-int8@v2 for the canary. Suggest 10% traffic for 48h with automated rollback rules (quality delta >1% absolute for critical prompts OR latency regresses >15%).
Carmen (SRE): Routing wise we can do weighted routing + fallback to the current model. We should run the canary during their lower-traffic window to limit blast radius.
Sam (Solutions): Also propose enabling prefix KV cache for recurrent sessions and a 20ms batching window for that tenant to reduce token cost without hurting latency.
Carmen (SRE): Example routing snippet I can apply (will run through infra PR):
```
routes:
  - match: tenant_id: arcadialabs
    weight: 0.10
    model: redwood/llama-compact-int8@v2
    fallback: redwood/llama-1.0@v1
    rollout: canary
```
Megan (CSM): I'll schedule a quick sync with Arcadia PM for Tues 09:00 PT to get approval. Linking the Optimize guide: https://www.redwood.ai/docs/optimize/int8-swap (internal).
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: canary_id=canary-5792468000-arcadia status=scheduled
Megan (CSM): Action items: 1) @Sam create canary config and PR, 2) @Devin wire eval pipeline + alert on quality thresholds, 3) @Carmen apply weighted route and monitor SLOs. We'll capture feedback in the onboarding playbook and surface to renewal owner in 30 days if perf improves. :thumbsup:
Sam (Solutions): On it — I'll post PR link and smoke test logs here when ready.
Devin (ML Eng): I'll kick off the automated eval before canary and set a Grafana alert if BLEU/ROUGE delta > 1% on the critical set.
Carmen (SRE): I'll coordinate the deployment window and keep an eye on GPU utilization and queue latency.
Megan (CSM): Thanks team — if the canary looks good we can propose a permanent model swap + routing change to help Arcadia hit their latency targets and improve unit economics.
